baseline.productionClassOrigin: Frozen compiled .57 ownership/planner classes, byte-for-byte verified against .57 universal jar

scope: Synthetic full resource mechanism phase, not Minecraft bodies, dispatch, outer region leasing, callbacks or server MSPT

comparison.harness: Same common harness separately compiled for both production versions; .57 expanded per-unit binding representation vs .58 fresh shared READ representation
comparison.semantics: Same actual object identities and per-unit logical resources/accesses, same whole-phase refusal rules; new grouped publication has one explicit pure current proof, not N unrelated callbacks
comparison.freshRevalidation: Every sample performs a second entire fresh capture and compares current permissions before reservation; current shared mode memoizes only equality of immutable identity sets within that comparison pass
comparison.claimShape: source/input/output WRITE; common region-local chunk-shaped READ; N explicit shared-publication READ objects
comparison.total: Direct wall elapsed through all six components, not a sum of independent quantiles
comparison.allocation: Coordinator thread bytes including both fresh captures, planning, reservation, scopes and release; excludes prebuilt inputs, returned timer array and output formatting; no worker allocations
comparison.aggregation: Median of the three round p50s and median of three round p95s per condition, not pooled-sample quantiles
comparison.competingWorkloads: No competing builds, tests or private servers; Gradle daemon stopped before timing

currentExpandedControl.scope: One additional current-version expanded-mode run using original per-unit binding representation; not a three-round independent performance claim

regressionsAndLimits: 2 units/4 shared: median full p50 and p95 regress; 16 units/4 shared p50 also slightly regresses
64 units/64 shared: median round p95 regresses despite much lower p50 and allocation; the accepted rounds and all component p95s are retained, no outlier was removed
Limited warmup/sample counts, JIT/deoptimization/GC/frequency/timer effects remain; no precise cause of tails attributed without a separate profile
Constant true validators omit the actual expensive mutable catalog/world checks and whole-phase inventory alias scans
Shared READ proof construction is inside both timed captures; sharing means one immutable publication per fresh preparation, not reusing a previous successful validation
Sequential scopes do not represent cross-core contention, task imbalance, running bodies or notification commits
Map/Binding/Resource/Unit allocation remains; bounded position/chunk Binding lookup may regress very large local footprints
The older .57 profile omitted fresh revalidation and must not be divided by these full-phase results
Earlier exploratory comparisons used pre-small-table-refinement source and asynchronous JIT; retained locally but excluded from final rounds
conclusion: Large shared footprints show substantial synthetic full-phase time/allocation reduction, but small shapes and some tails still regress. No whole-server performance benefit, default-on suitability or expanded BE admission is established.
